steps.title: Implement 3D Skeuomorphic Drawables
steps.description: Generate layer-lists and vector gradients to establish realistic 3D shadow depths and color-rich aesthetics for background, cards, and buttons.

steps.title: Synthesize Immersive Launch and Physics Tones
steps.description: Enhance the SoundHelper with programmatic synthesizer beeps, a progressive launch arpeggio, a bouncing boundary tick, and a toss audio swoosh.

steps.title: Design Custom Physics Gravity Canvas
steps.description: Develop a customized dynamic physics engine inside GravityView.java rendering physical ball entities that bounce, collide, and react to manual taps and programmatic gravity parameters.

steps.title: Construct Gradient-Themed Dashboard Interface
steps.description: Revamp the primary activity_main.xml layout, embedding the interactive gravity workspace, dark space gradient styles, and custom progress spinner configurations.

steps.title: Introduce Launch Progression Controller
steps.description: Update MainActivity.java to bind progress UI elements, play audio alerts on app startup, and drive a smooth timed percentage loading sequence with status alerts.

steps.title: Integrate Gravity Playground with Transactions
steps.description: Bind user record databases dynamically to the interactive 3D physics engine so transaction categories and values visually map inside the bouncy environment.

steps.title: Add App Metadata Configuration
steps.description: Configure app-meta.json to confirm exact package and project namespaces.

steps.title: Building Expense Tracker Pro
steps.description: Build, compile, and assemble the fully styled 3D physical layout and dynamic auditory simulation app.
